title: My Sure and Steady Rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I climbed up on the little wall,
My legs began to sway;
But Heavenly Father held me there
And steadied me to stay.

[Chorus]
He is my sure and steady Rock,
He never moves away;
So plant your feet and do not fear,
He holds you every day.

[Verse 2]
A house is built on one strong stone,
The corner, set just right;
And Heavenly Father holds my house
Through every windy night.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The world can wibble, wobble, shake,
The ground can rock and roll;
But I am standing safe and sure,
He holds me, heart and soul.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So breathe in slow and close your eyes,
The dark is not too deep;
You're standing on the strongest Rock,
He'll hold you while you sleep.

[Chorus]
mood: Standing music. A slow planted pulse that never hurries and never drifts - one foot set, then the other, the way a child tests a low wall and finds it holds every time. A cello holding one long low note underneath while the guitar answers above it in short, sure phrases that always land where you expect them. It travels from testing to certain, each verse settling a little lower, until the last one barely moves at all.
